title: PluginMarketplaceValidationReport

commit_sha.title: Commit Sha
commit_sha.description: The full SHA of the commit that was validated: for a repository, the commit that was read; for an uploaded archive, the commit recorded in the archive's comment (as a Git host's download writes it; not verified), else null.

manifest_error.title: Manifest Error
manifest_error.description: Set when nothing could be validated: the repository or archive could not be read, or marketplace.json is missing, malformed or over a limit. Null otherwise.

manifest_error_code.title: Manifest Error Code
manifest_error_code.description: A stable identifier for `manifest_error`; null when that is.

plugin_errors.title: Plugin Errors
plugin_errors.description: One entry per plugin a synchronization would skip entirely, keyed by the plugin's name in marketplace.json.

plugin_warnings.title: Plugin Warnings
plugin_warnings.description: One entry per plugin that would synchronize with some of its contents left out, keyed by the plugin's name in marketplace.json.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: For a repository, the branch that was read by name: the one requested, or else the branch a synchronization of this repository is set to read. Null when no branch is named or set and the repository's default branch was read, for a request by commit SHA, and for an uploaded archive.

total_plugin_count.title: Total Plugin Count
total_plugin_count.description: How many plugins marketplace.json declares; 0 when it could not be read.

valid.title: Valid
valid.description: True when marketplace.json is well-formed and no plugin would be skipped; warnings never make it false.

description:
The outcome of validating plugin marketplace content: a report, not a
stored object, so nothing in it can be retrieved afterwards.
